title: Worksheet 9: Keeping Your Account Secure (V2.0)
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: An account's password is one of the most important tools for keeping a Roblox account safe from being accessed by someone else. A strong password should be different from passwords used on other websites or apps, should not include easy-to-guess information like a birthday or pet's name, and should never be shared with anyone, including friends, since sharing a password removes control over who can log in and make changes. If another player somehow gains access to an account, they could change settings, spend real money on items, message other players while pretending to be the account owner, or even lock the real owner out completely. Roblox also offers a security feature called two-step verification, which requires entering a special code, usually sent to an email or phone, in addition to a password before logging in, making it much harder for someone else to access the account even if they somehow learned the password. Turning on two-step verification is one of the simplest ways to add an extra layer of protection to an account.

questions.text: According to the paragraph, a strong password should:
questions.correct: Be different from passwords used on other websites and apps
distractors: Be the same everywhere so it is easy to recall

questions.text: According to the paragraph, what does two-step verification require?
questions.correct: A special code, usually sent to an email or phone, in addition to a password
distractors: A password typed twice in a row

questions.text: According to the paragraph, which of these could happen if someone gains access to an account?
questions.correct: They could spend real money on items
distractors: They could delete Roblox for everyone
They could see the player's home address
They could change the player's real name

questions.text: According to the paragraph, why should a password never be shared, even with friends?
questions.correct: Sharing removes control over who can log in and make changes
distractors: Friends can only use it for one day
Roblox charges a fee for shared accounts

questions.text: Someone learns a player's password but the account has two-step verification turned on. Based on the paragraph, what happens?
questions.correct: It is much harder for them to get in, because they still need the special code
distractors: They can log in normally with the password
The account is deleted for safety
The password changes by itself instantly
